jobs.title: Early Careers: Junior C#/SQL Developer & Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Posting Description:
**Early Careers: Junior C\#/ SQL Developer \& Data Analytics**  

Are you curious about the Insurance industry? Interested in working with a team of experts who are generous with sharing their knowledge, and joining an industry leading, highly inclusive organization? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!  

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Montreal office. **Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.** **Aon is in the business of better decisions**  

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. **What the day will look like*** Maintaining and enhancing our in‑house applications built primarily with C\#, .NET and Microsoft SQL Server, including adding new features, improving usability, and solving bugs raised by users.
* Fulfilling ad‑hoc data requests from colleagues by writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, validate and format information from our systems for business, operational and reporting needs.
* Building and supporting automation solutions (mail merge, Excel macros, C\# utilities and SQL Server scripts) that streamline office workflows and improve efficiency.
* Acting as a liaison between business users and Aon IT, helping to translate user requirements into technical requests (e.g., application changes, folder or network access, permission updates).
* Partnering with Aon IT teams to coordinate and test system upgrades, patches and infrastructure changes, ensuring our C\#/.NET and SQL Server–based applications remain stable and available with minimal downtime.
* Developing and maintaining business reports (for example, attendance and other key performance or operational reports) using tools such as Crystal Reports, Excel and SQL Server.
* Documenting changes, processes and user guides to support knowledge transfer and provide clear references for both technical teams and non‑technical users.
* Participating in regular team meetings to discuss priorities, review upcoming work, and contribute ideas for improving our systems and processes

 **How this opportunity is different**  

This role provides an opportunity to observe the full lifecycle of internal tools and applications, from understanding end‑user needs through composing, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will have direct contact with business users, giving you a clear view of how your work improves efficiency and supports critical day‑to‑day operations. You will be working for a business unit supporting high profile clients in the professional services industries, operating in multiple insurance markets (US, UK, Bermuda, Canada) and will have the chance to interact with people from all those locations.


We are a small team, you will gain broad, hands‑on experience across application development, data/reporting, automation and basic infrastructure coordination rather than being limited to a narrow specialization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues in both the business and Aon IT, with opportunities for mentorship, on‑the‑job learning and exposure to enterprise‑grade tools and environments.


The systems you support are important to our business; you will quickly see the impact of your work and be encouraged to propose and implement improvements.

 **Skills and experience that will lead to success**  

* Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Software engineering, Computer science, Programming specialization, Information technology specialization, Systems Administration, or a relevant field;
* Hands‑on experience with C\# (preferably using WPF) in Visual Studio, including building and debugging desktop applications (academic, internship, or professional);
* Understanding of object‑oriented programming and development protocols;
* Solid understanding of SQL, with a strong preference for Microsoft SQL Server (writing queries, joins, basic performance tuning, and simple stored procedures);
* Experience with Microsoft Access for database queries, table design, and relationships
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for basic web pages and user interfaces
* Strong Excel skills (formulas, functions, sorting/filtering)
* Experience integrating C\# applications with Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Outlook, Word) programmatically is an asset
* Basic understanding of SharePoint
* Experience with Kentico or Sitecore is an asset
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written;
* French / English bilingualism required due to frequent interactions with clients, colleagues, or partners based in Quebec, other Canadian provinces and/or internationally.
* High discernment and professional presentation skills.

 ***Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.***

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer - Engineered Arts
jobs.description:
### **About Engineered Arts**



Engineered Arts is the leading manufacturer of full\-size humanoid robots used for entertainment, education and communication. With 20 years of hardware and software development, our robots have been sold in over 30 countries worldwide with customers such as NASA, PwC, Meta and many more.



Our Ameca robot is well known as 'the face of AI' and a social media viral success, taking advantage of the generative AI craze. Along with our ultra\-realistic Mesmer range of animated figures, our robots continue to surprise and excite visitors at museums, theme parks, visitor attractions and trade shows, as well as aid leading universities with AI and robotics research. Our robots are poised to break into the future mega\-expansion service robot segment, with applications such as front of house, receptions, check\-in desks, information points and PoS.



We are a team of dedicated Developers and creatives striving to develop the very best experiences for our customers. Our internal motto is 'Be Wow' — everything we do is fun, entertaining or surprising to encounter.


### **About You**



You're a mid\-to\-senior full stack developer with a strong backend focus who thrives building reliable, scalable cloud software. You've shipped production features across APIs, data layers, and AI pipelines — and you know what it takes to build services that hold up under real\-world conditions. You bring strong Python skills, deep comfort with Django and GraphQL, and the debugging instincts to trace a problem across backend layers, services, and integrations.



You care about architecture, but you're pragmatic — you understand that systems powering physical products demand robustness, repeatability, and thoughtful failure modes, not just elegant abstractions. You can integrate quickly into a large, mature codebase, deliver value early, and keep quality high even as scope evolves. You're energised by ambiguity, patient with complexity, and motivated by the moment a customer's robot does something that genuinely creates wonder in the real world.


### **What You'll Do and How You'll Have an Impact**


* Design, implement, and evolve GraphQL APIs and Python/Django backend services, writing clean, tested, and scalable code across API and data layers
* Integrate and productise LLMs and AI pipelines — including streaming, tool calling, RAG/knowledge bases, and multi\-provider TTS/STT — turning ambiguous agent behaviour into clear product contracts with defined schemas, permissions, fallbacks, and observability
* Optimise AI\-powered robot experiences for latency, cost, and robustness — building conversational experiences that feel natural on a physical humanoid, not just in a controlled demo environment
* Build and maintain backend services that power fleet configuration, agent behaviour, and realtime telepresence surfaces
* Debug complex backend issues, and proactively improve testability, observability, and maintainability as you go
* Partner with product, UX, DevOps, QA, and embedded engineers to turn requirements into shippable, high\-quality designs — providing technical feedback on feasibility, risk, and sequencing
* Coach and support more junior developers; raise the bar for quality across a complex, fast\-moving codebase

### **What We're Looking For**


* Mid\-to\-senior experience shipping production software as a full stack developer, with clear backend strength
* Strong Python backend experience; Django strongly preferred, or clear transferable experience
* Experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs — not only REST
* Comfortable working on Linux systems, debugging remote services, and navigating logs, processes, and packaging/deploy workflows
* Solid Git and collaborative development practices; writes tested, maintainable code and understands CI/CD
* Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
* Clear communication and collaboration with product, design, and other disciplines

### **Our Stack**


* **Frontend:** TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Material\-UI
* **Backend:** Python, Django, PostgreSQL, WebSockets
* **On\-robot / AI:** Async Python on Linux, LLM/TTS/STT integrations, RAG
* **Delivery:** Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI


*Strong fundamentals and the ability to ramp into an existing codebase matter more than having used every tool before.*


### **Nice to Have**


* React / TypeScript frontend exposure — familiarity with how backend APIs are consumed in the UI is a plus
* Production experience with LLMs and related systems: streaming, tool/function calling, RAG/knowledge bases, multi\-provider TTS/STT, and latency/cost trade\-offs
* Async/event\-driven systems experience — asyncio, WebSockets, pub/sub messaging such as NATS or equivalents
* Realtime experience — WebRTC, media/signalling pipelines, or other latency\-sensitive architectures
* Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS or similar)
* Strong debugging and observability habits — structured logs, metrics, and tracing
* C\+\+ and/or Rust
* Prior experience in robotics, human–robot interaction, conversational agents, or MCP/tool\-platform integrations
* OpenTelemetry or similar production telemetry experience

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product - Backend)
jobs.description:
**About Vasco**
---------------


Vasco is the revenue context layer for AI agents. The product was built around one idea: confident is not the same as correct, and revenue decisions get made on confidence all the time. We structure your CRM, billing, calls, and support data into a semantic layer where every metric is sourced, every definition is locked, and every answer is deterministic, then build agents that take the manual busywork off people's plates.


Our cofounders Guillaume and Seb already built and sold one startup together; today they are building the product they wished they had. Vasco's mission is to enable builders and GTM leaders to build a revenue engine that moves the business forward on data they can trust.


Curious how we build? Take a look at our young engineering blog.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Software Engineer at Vasco, you'll build the brain of our agents: the core systems that give them the context, metrics, and playbooks they need to do their job. You'll join a small team of product designers and engineers reporting to our CTO, and work closely with our DevOps, Platform, Data, and Agent teams. The mission is to make GTM agents production\-ready: reliable, fast, context\-aware, and triggered at the right moment. You'll help shape solutions, then carry them through implementation to release. Twelve months in, winning means our agents run on systems you shaped, shipped, and saw adopted, and you’re able to tackle hard and crunchy problems.


We're open to different levels of seniority. This is not an entry\-level position: the problems are hard, the architecture is complex, and you'll own technical decisions and their implementation. We expect high autonomy and accountability at every level, and the scope you own grows with your experience. We'll meet you where you are, and what matters is that you make the team better and more capable of facing complex technical challenges.


We're an early\-stage startup working at the frontier of what agents can do in GTM. The path is often foggy, so you should be ready to bring clarity to it with your team, stretch beyond your comfort zone, stay open\-minded, and wear more hats than your title suggests. You're AI\-forward and you actively contribute to how we work with AI as a team. AI can make engineering lonely, and we push back on that with close collaboration, a fun environment, and a team that stays human.

*For transparency, the internal title for this role is Software Developer.*

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Backend\-focused, full\-slice development:** Design, build, and ship the backend behind Vasco, including challenging parts like our context graph and our metric engine, where formula accuracy is key, and own full slices of work, including front end and data visualization when the feature calls for it, with human review sized to the risk.
* **Shaping to adoption:** Shape solutions with designers, engineers, and GTM teammates in our Shape Up process, at the technical level and the business level, turn intent and design into the right context for Claude to implement, then instrument the release and follow adoption with your team.
* **Infrastructure, security, and data trust:** Build services that handle customer revenue data safely and own the infrastructure and security of the parts you build, with guidance and tooling from DevOps, since the product's promise rests on data our customers can trust.
* **AI\-native practices:** Help build our backend harness and blueprints, the standards Claude reads so it builds the way we want, so more of your time goes to thinking, technical design, and shaping as AI handles more of the mechanical coding.
* **Incident ownership:** Own your incidents: if you break something in production, you fix it, and you step up for your team the same way, communicating fast and transparently so we know about problems before customers do, because reliability is what we sell.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Customer\-facing systems.** You've spent at least four years building systems that have touched customers, and your technical decisions trace back to the customer problems they solve.
* **Backend depth.** You've designed, built, and operated production backend services, you design complete systems with the big picture of a feature in mind, and you're comfortable working on a data\-heavy infrastructure product like ours. Experience with part of our stack (GCP, BigQuery, Node.js, TypeScript, Terraform) or its equivalents in other clouds is ideal.
* **AI\-forward, with healthy skepticism.** You've made AI coding tools central to how you ship, you own and can defend the output you ship, and you build the checks that let you ship with evidence. We'll ask you to show how you run your development lifecycle with AI.
* **High\-stakes judgment.** You've made decisions where the cost of being wrong was real, at the scale you've worked at, and you can walk through how you decided.
* **Communication clarity.** You can turn technical trade\-offs into clear business impact for any audience, from developers to cofounders.
* **Collaboration.** You've pulled people into your work, you enjoy working as a team, and you contribute to the culture around you.

**What'll make you stand out**
------------------------------

* **Rust or Go.** You've shipped production services in Rust or Go, which we're seriously considering alongside TypeScript and Node for high\-performance, type\-safe workloads.
* **Context layers for agents.** You've built data or context layers that AI agents consume in production, including context graph architectures.
* **Data engineering or DevOps range.** You can drop into data engineering work (SQL, data modeling, pipelines) or DevOps work (infrastructure, CI/CD, observability) when the problem calls for it.

jobs.title: Software Developer - Applications
jobs.description:
**About Nakisa**

Nakisa is a global leader in AI\-powered enterprise software for Human Resources, Financial Management, and Commercial Real Estate (CRE). Our cloud platform powers mission\-critical operations for 1,100\+ organizations in 135 countries and serves millions of users.

We are building the next wave of enterprise applications with Nakisa AI. Our products use retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) with secure API integrations to large language models. Customer data stays private and auditable, and we never use client data to train third\-party models. This privacy\-first design gives enterprises trustworthy AI they can run in production.

What sets us apart is a single platform that connects these functions on shared data models, a focus on high\-stakes, compliance\-heavy workflows, and a culture anchored in Fairness, Integrity, Service, and Humility. Recognized among Canada's top employers, we offer hybrid work, supportive leaders, and clear growth paths. Join us to ship reliable, privacy\-first AI at global scale.  



**About the role**



As a Software Developer at Nakisa, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, cloud\-native applications used by Fortune 1000 companies around the world. Working within an Agile team, you will contribute to the full software lifecycle — from architecture and design through implementation, testing, and deployment — helping evolve our product portfolio to meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and security. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and DevOps as part of our continued shift toward NoOps\-driven, cloud\-native delivery.


**What** **you'll** **be doing**


* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and their corresponding frontend components.
* Design and optimize APIs, database schemas, and system architectures.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and maintainable code that follows established best practices and design patterns.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver high\-quality software on schedule.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Take ownership of assigned components, ensuring their performance, scalability, and reliability, and support related production issues.
* Work within an Agile, Test\-Driven Development (TDD) environment, contributing to sprint planning and continuous improvement.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Codex) to improve development speed and code quality.
* Continuously explore and help introduce new technologies, tools, and best practices across the team.


**What you bring**


* A genuine passion for software development — you enjoy the craft, take pride in your code, and are always looking for a better way to build something.
* A strong drive to learn: you're eager to pick up our stack (Java, Spring Boot, Vue.js, and beyond) and quickly become fluent in new tools, frameworks, and technologies.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, with a solid foundation in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and common design patterns.
* Curiosity about full stack development — comfortable moving between backend (Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs) and frontend (Vue.js, Angular, or React) work, and excited to deepen that range.
* A self\-starter mindset: you take ownership of problems, ask good questions, and are comfortable working both independently and as part of an Agile team.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a genuine enjoyment of technical challenges.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the openness to give and receive feedback in code reviews and design discussions.
* Comfort thriving in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities and technologies shift.


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Experience with Java 17\+ and building scalable applications using microservice architecture.
* Proficiency with DevOps and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.
* Knowledge of cloud computing environments (AWS, Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with front\-end build tools (Webpack, Babel) and state management libraries (Vuex, Pinia, or similar).
* Experience with data engineering tools such as Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, Elasticsearch, or Apache Flink.
* Experience with data visualization libraries such as D3\.js, Plotly, or ECharts.
* Understanding of the HR or Financial domain space.
* Proficiency in French and English is an asset for collaboration across our Quebec\-based and global teams.


**What's** **in it for you?**


* Work on cutting\-edge, cloud\-native applications as part of a dynamic and forward\-thinking team.
* Be part of a company that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

### **Why Nakisa?**


 **Flexibility**: Hybrid work (1–2 days in our downtown Montréal office).
 **Time off:** Starting at 3 weeks' vacation, a paid week off at year end, an extra paid summer day off, personal and volunteer days, and generous sick leave.
 **Health \& wellness:** Comprehensive health, dental, and life insurance including telemedicine from day one.
 **Financial security:** RRSP matching up to 4% from day one and a home internet allowance.
 **Active lifestyle:** Free gym access in our downtown office building and half\-price Bixi membership.
 **Social perks:** Regular events to unwind with colleagues such as game nights, summer picnic, holiday party, excursions, and more.
 **Career growth:** Mentorship, education assistance (80% up to $1,500 per year) and reimbursement of role\-relevant professional dues.
 **Culture:** A supportive, values\-driven team with leaders who care.

 **Make your impact at Nakisa.**

If building privacy\-first AI for global enterprises motivates you, apply today and help shape the future of enterprise software.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Emergency Call Handling
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez\-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez\-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.
  

  

Présentation du département:
  

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9\-1\-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.  



  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real\-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission\-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

  

  

What You’ll Do


* Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
* Develop Agentic AI\-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
* Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
* Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.
  

  

You Might Be a Fit If


* You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI\-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high\-impact challenge.
* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
  

  

Relevant Experience


We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.


Relevant exposure may include:


* Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
* Real\-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low\-latency audio transport.
* Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
* Programming in Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, or similar languages
* Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

  

  

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 \- $90,000 CAD

jobs.title: Analytics & AI Developer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**



What if your users could simply ask? We’re building **TSIQ**, an AI\-powered analytics and intelligence platform that answers questions, recommends actions, and runs workflows for the people who use TS Imagine’s **Trading, Risk and Prime Brokerage** products. As an Analytics \& AI Developer you’ll build both the foundation and the intelligence on top of it—the data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that make our data trustworthy, and the AI agents that turn it into answers. You'll be part of our dynamic **Data \& Analytics Office**, a globally distributed, high\-impact team that processes trillions of data points and manages our cutting\-edge data lake built on **Snowflake**.



This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data engineering, semantic modeling, and applied AI—on a product that is being defined as you build it. We have multiple openings across levels, from intermediate through senior.


**Why You’ll Love This Role**



This position is perfect for:


* **Data Modelers:** You believe a great answer starts with a well\-designed model, and you take pride in structuring data so others can trust it.
* **Applied AI Builders:** You’re fluent in prompt and context engineering, and you’re energized by making AI agents reliable rather than merely impressive.
* **Analytical Minds:** You enjoy delving into complex data sets and ensuring the highest quality for accurate decision\-making.
* **Problem Framers:** You’re comfortable sitting with a business stakeholder, untangling a vague request, and turning it into something buildable.
* **Storytellers:** You're comfortable presenting complex data and AI\-driven insights in a way that engages and excites stakeholders.
* **Action Takers:** You thrive on challenges, taking ownership of a variety of responsibilities to deliver high\-quality results.
* **Lifelong Learners:** You're always eager to step outside your comfort zone and dive into the intricacies of one of the most complex business domains.
* **Collaborative Teammates:** You possess the technical and interpersonal skills to excel in a cutting\-edge software development environment.


**What You’ll Do**


* Design and build the data models and pipelines that power TSIQ.
* Develop semantic models so that AI agents reason over trading, risk, and prime brokerage data with precision and consistency.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI agents using prompt engineering and context engineering.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation, and governance controls that keep AI agents accurate, safe, and auditable.
* Deliver analytics and rapid prototypes in Streamlit to put capabilities in front of users early.
* Perform business analysis—gather requirements from stakeholders, translate them into technical designs, and validate that what we ship answers the real question.
* Collaborate with a global team of developers in a fast\-paced, innovative setting.


**What You Bring**


* Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with Snowflake.
* Proficiency in Python, including the ability to contribute to structured, production\-grade codebases—not just notebooks.
* Experience designing data models and building data pipelines, including transformation frameworks such as dbt.
* Semantic modeling experience—defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic that downstream consumers depend on.
* Practical prompt engineering and context engineering skills, with a focus on making AI outputs reliable and repeatable.
* Experience building AI agents and implementing guardrails to govern their behavior (a strong plus).
* Streamlit or comparable experience building lightweight data applications.
* Business analysis skills—requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and documentation.
* Exceptional communication skills. This role sits between business stakeholders and the platform, so clear written and verbal communication is essential.
* Capital markets or financial services domain experience. This is extremely important to us—understanding trading, risk, or prime brokerage workflows will set you apart.


**Why Join TS Imagine?**


* On\-site role—4 days per week in our Montreal office, with 1 day of flexibility.
* Unlimited vacation \+ 3 personal days.
* Annual bonus and salary review.
* $1,500 training budget to fuel your growth.
* RRSP matching (3% company contribution).
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* Subsidized public transportation (Opus \& Cie).
* Join a global team with 10 offices worldwide and the opportunity to make a real impact on the financial industry.


Note: This role is not remote—applicants must be based in Montreal.



If you're excited by AI, rigorous about data, and ready to help build something new, we want to hear from you!

As a Computer Vision Software Developer II, you will work on Computer Vision projects turning Zebra's core algorithms from prototypes to high\-quality product ready code. Nakisa is a global leader in AI\-powered enterprise software for Human Resources, Financial Management, and Commercial Real Estate (CRE). Our cloud platform powers mission\-critical operations for 1,100\+ organizations in 135 countries and serves millions of users.

We are building the next wave of enterprise applications with Nakisa AI. Our products use retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) with secure API integrations to large language models. Customer data stays private and auditable, and we never use client data to train third\-party models. This privacy\-first design gives enterprises trustworthy AI they can run in production.

* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work well in an Agile environment.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Proficiency in data modeling, ETL pipelines, and database management (SQL, NoSQL).

* Understanding of the HR or Financial domain space.
* Proficiency in French and English is an asset for collaboration across our Quebec\-based and global teams.


**What's in it for you?**


* Work on cutting\-edge, cloud\-native platform technology

* Be part of a company that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

  



### **Why Nakisa?**


 **Flexibility**: Hybrid work (1–2 days in our downtown Montréal office).

 **Health \& wellness:** Comprehensive health, dental, and life insurance including telemedicine from day one.

jobs.description:
**Division: IT**
**Job location: Remote (Canada)**  

**Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday**  

**Employment type: Permanent**  

**Salary: $111,000 – $137,000**  


**A little about us**  



Aurora is proud to be a global leader in the cannabis industry. With a smart strategy, unmatched talent and focus on our long\-term success, we believe we have a bright future.  

  

At Aurora, we’re passionate about helping patients improve their lives through high\-quality premium medical cannabis under brands they can trust and rely on. Our products, available across Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand, include leading brands like Pedanios, IndiMed, San Raf, Whistler, Greybeard and CraftPlant.  

Our diverse team works passionately across various roles, from manufacturing to corporate positions, and many more, united by our purpose: **Opening the World to Cannabis**. Enabled by science and empowered by people, for patients and consumers. We collaborate globally, embrace change with courage, stay agile, and treat everyone with compassion. We live our values daily, making a meaningful impact on patients, communities, and our A\-Team.  


**Job Summary**  



The **Full\-Stack Developer** is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing web applications, eCommerce solutions, and business system integrations across the organization. This role focuses on full\-stack development, custom Shopify solutions, and integrations with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\) and other third\-party platforms and APIs.  



Working collaboratively with Product, UI/UX, QA, Marketing, and business stakeholders, the Full\-Stack Developer translates business and technical requirements into reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions. The role participates throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing application support.  



The **Full\-Stack Developer** also contributes to technical solution decisions, application performance and reliability improvements, Agile development processes, and the evaluation of third\-party solutions versus custom development to support the organization’s evolving technology needs. Interesting? Here is a little more…  

**As a Full\-Stack Developer you will…**
* **Full\-Stack Development**: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable full\-stack web applications, robust custom Shopify solutions, and integrated Dynamics 365 (D365\) backend components.
* **Technical Leadership**: Own project lifecycles from concept to deployment, guiding architectural decisions and mentoring junior team members.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Partner with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, QA, Marketing, and business stakeholders to execute the long\-term technology roadmap.
* **System Resilience**: Ensure high availability, deep observability, and performance optimization across all customer\-facing applications.
* **Agile Execution:** Participate actively in Agile sprint ceremonies, adhering to strictly defined Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) best practices.
* **Buy vs. Build Analysis**: Evaluate third\-party tools, APIs, and Shopify apps against custom development to recommend optimal technical solutions.

  


**You will be setup for success if you have…**
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional web development experience, with at least 3\+ years dedicated to enterprise\-level Shopify development.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional debugging, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non\-technical stakeholders.

  


**Bonus points if you have…**
* **Shopify Ecosystem:** Deep expertise in Shopify platform architecture, including Liquid, custom App development (Node.js/Remix), Shopify APIs (GraphQL/REST), and Shopify Functions/Checkout extensibility. Headless commerce experience using React is a strong asset.
* **Frontend Stack:** Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, HTML5, and CSS/SASS.
* **Backend \& Databases:** Strong backend development experience using Node.js, Java, C\# or PHP, coupled with NoSQL/SQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB).
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Hands\-on experience architecting and managing infrastructure within AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, CloudFront, Route53\) and Microsoft Azure.
* **Tools \& Workflows:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, shell scripting, and version control systems like Bitbucket/GitHub.
* **Testing \& Quality:** Proven track record of implementing comprehensive unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing frameworks.
* **Strategic Problem Solving:** Ability to think strategically, problem solve and make quick decisions.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Client\-facing experience would be considered an asset.
* **Agile Adaptability:** Ability to work in a dynamic fast paced environment.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Felix**


Founded in 2019, Felix is a digital healthcare company that puts the patient in control of their own health and well\-being. We’re passionate about building technology and beautiful customer experiences to make healthcare more accessible (and more enjoyable) for all Canadians.


Felix is Canada's first end\-to\-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery and ongoing care. We deliver care across a growing range of daily health categories such as weight loss, birth control, menopause, erectile dysfunction, acne and more.**‍**

 **Description**


We are looking for Intermediate and Senior Engineers to join the Felix Engineering team!


You will write the code and build the architecture that supports our proprietary digital healthcare ecosystem. Our developer roles are all full stack (Vue.js, PHP/Laravel). You will work in collaboration with teammates and will be fundamentally responsible for the technical requirements and management of our front\-end and back\-end systems that power our patient, health\-care practitioner and pharmacist experiences. You will work cross\-functionally with our product \& design teams to deliver innovative, industry\-transforming products and experiences that drive patient acquisition, engagement and retention.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build our back\-end system and front\-end systems including architectural patterns, technical specifications and designs to managing our database
* Write code and build the software that will allow us to scale as we launch new products, enter new markets and expand into new healthcare categories
* Help us improve the reliability of our platform through rigorous testing, observability, and monitoring and identify areas for system optimization and improvement
* Manage the flows of communication between all levels of the stack to maximize efficiency and establish sound engineering practices and frameworks
* Mentor junior members of the team

 **Requirements**

* Have 3\+ years of experience as a full\-stack software engineer, building scalable web applications
* Familiarity with relevant tools and technologies, such as PHP/Laravel, JavaScript and Vue, with a drive to stay up\-to\-date with ongoing changes and advancements
* Leadership skills in unblocking and leading development teams
* Clear communication around technical concepts and can collaborate with Product
* Comfort with ambiguity, an ability to create clarity and eagerness to problem solve and move projects and the team forward

 **Benefits**

* Full medical, dental and vision benefits
* Maternity/paternity policy
* 4 weeks vacation (3 weeks anytime \+ 1 week during the holidays)
* Competitive compensation
* Stock option grant
* Remote first, work from anywhere in Canada
* Incredible culture powered by a highly collaborative and high\-performing team
* Large impact at an early\-stage technology company
* Professional development opportunities, working closely with founders and the senior leadership team

 **Seniority Levels: Intermediate and Senior positions available**

**Open vacancy:** This posting is for existing vacancies at the company.

**Location:** Toronto, Remote (Canada). We have an office in Toronto, but are currently working remotely and open to candidates from anywhere in Canada.

 *Our commitment to an inclusive team culture means embracing diversity and offering equitable access to opportunities and resources for people who might otherwise be excluded. During our recruitment process, we provide accommodations at any stage. Candidates can communicate their accommodation needs to the hiring manager directly or by emailing accessibility@felixforyou.ca.*

 **Recruitment Fraud Alert**  

**Please note**: We have been made aware of fraudulent recruiting activities where individuals pose as Felix representatives.

* Communication: We will only ever contact you from an official **@****felixforyou.ca** email address.
* Interviews: All interviews are conducted via Google Meet; we never interview via text\-only platforms (like Telegram or WhatsApp).
* Payments: We will never ask for credit card information, bank details, or payments for "equipment" or "onboarding" during the application process.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $160K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, S3 Discovery
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Managing trillions of objects in storage, retrieving them in sub\-x ms, building software that deploys to tens of thousands of hosts, achieving 99\.999999999% (you didn’t read that wrong, that’s 11 nines!) durability. These are just a few of the numbers that give you a sense of the scale of the exciting problems you will find every day working in Simple Storage Service (S3\). Amazon S3 powers businesses across e globe that make the lives of consumers better daily. Whether its electronic content delivered to your home, technology that betters your remote working experience, allows you to plan travel to exotic places or simply get stuff delivered to your home.  

  

As a Software Development Engineer in the S3 Distribution Plane team, you will deliver services at scale to delight our customers and support the routing of billions of requests per minute to S3’s globally distributed server fleet. You will have the opportunity to design and develop systems and services in the domains of DNS, IP and Network Connectivity, TLS Certificates, VPC Endpoints and Private Connectivity. You will work alongside engineers and leaders who obsess about operations, performance, availability, scalability, and durability of customer data. Our services run at scale worldwide and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to ship code often, and see the impact your code has on a wide range of S3 customers.  

  

Day to day you will be responsible for designing, delivering and maintaining the operational health of our services, maintaining our build \& release systems, and ensuring maximum up\-time for our developers and customers. You will provide coaching and mentoring for junior engineers and participate in design reviews, operations meetings and leadership discussions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to build ground\-breaking DNS, networking and security solutions in code for S3\. You will work closely with the likes of Amazon Route 53, AWS EC2 and AWS Networking to achieve the combined goals of AWS and S3\. You will transcend a single organization in order to deliver solutions that require broader integration across AWS. For this reason, thinking big and thinking outside of S3 is one of the key tenets you will have to practise on a daily basis.  

  

As a Software Development Engineer in our team, you are constantly striving to raise our operational bar and improve our infrastructure, enabling our teams to move faster. Your responsibilities will include:  

  

Developing tools to streamline operations as we scale to reduce operational load and improve our overall operational posture. Influencing \& driving operational excellence and best practices within the organization.  

  

Identifying ways to increase the automate and improve our test infrastructure and make our CI/CD more robust and flexible.  

  

Playing a key role in investigating and recommending best practices for maintaining and improving code quality, fleet health, and security \& reliability of our service.  

  

Growing our talent through actively mentor junior system development engineers, improving their skills, their knowledge of our systems, and their ability to get things done.  

  

Sharing your knowledge with wider teams and writing clear and concise documentation to allow other system development engineers to get the most out of the service and tools.  

  

Our team works together to provide work/life balance for all team members. We recognize that the circumstances of our team members vary, and we balance work across the team so that we’re all able to maintain high standards on behalf of our customers, while at the same time allowing for rich and happy personal lives.  

  

In AWS, if you build it, you own it. S3 is a highly available 7x24 worldwide service requiring dedicated support from our engineering teams. We pride ourselves on a high level of ownership in the work we do. This means we hold a high bar for test automation, verification processes, design and code reviews to ensure that our systems meet the exacting standards our customers demand. We maintain a regular on\-call rotation across our teams with engineers and managers all taking part to resolve the inevitable issues that arise. We work hard to minimize getting paged in the middle of the night as we recognize that a well\-rested employee is a productive employee.  

  

Upon joining S3, every employee is paired with a peer buddy who will help you to quickly come up to speed in understanding the technology we’re building, the tools we use and the business problems we’re trying to solve. We hire exceptional people and we recognize the importance of coaching others. We have a formal mentor search application that lets you find a mentor that works best for you based on location, job family, and job level. On our internal “Broadcast” video streaming website, you’ll find countless presentations by some of the brightest minds in computing discussing solutions to many of the exciting problems we’re solving in AWS today with new live\-streaming videos added every week.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

Our team puts a high value on work\-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance be

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer-REMOTE
jobs.description:
**Fully Remote, Coast to Coast**
--------------------------------

  

Peloton is a fully remote company — there's no office to relocate for, no expectation of "a few days a week." Our team is spread across Canada, and we've built our tools, meetings, and culture around that. Wherever in Canada you call home, that's where you'll work.  



  

**About Peloton Technologies**
------------------------------

At Peloton Technologies, we’re transforming the payments landscape for small businesses and enterprises alike. Our platform helps business owners manage payments, optimize cash flow, and streamline operations — from seamless point\-of\-sale transactions to enterprise payment solutions. By building smarter, more connected payments infrastructure, we make it easier for businesses to thrive.


Founded in 2010 on Vancouver Island, Peloton has grown into a national brand with a team working remotely across Canada. Our culture is grounded in five core values — Teamwork, Respect, Trust, Innovation, and Passion — that shape how we collaborate and make decisions.  



  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a Junior Software Developer to join our team. Reporting to the Director, Software Development, you will design, develop, and test financial applications, independently creating small features and contributing to medium\-sized features with support from other developers. Collaborating with the team, you’ll help determine solutions for end users’ needs and work with end user requirements to design and develop code that delivers effective solutions. By applying common design and architectural patterns, you’ll help enhance software structure and functionality while developing and maintaining adequate tests to ensure code correctness and reliability.


This is a great opportunity for someone early in their development career who’s eager to learn and grow. You bring a passion for coding and a commitment to best practices, along with good communication skills and a genuine willingness to pick up new tools and technologies. You enjoy working closely with a team and bringing your own ideas to the table.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Contributions and Expertise**


* Write clean and efficient code and practice the software development lifecycle with supervision from the team.
* Determine possible solutions to the end users' needs with assistance from colleagues.
* Work with end user requirements, designing and developing code to create solutions.
* Apply common design and architectural patterns with direction from the team.
* Write adequate tests to ensure the correctness of code.
* Learn at least one technical area (eg. web application development, database design, API integration, etc.).
* Continuously improve technical skills and stay updated on emerging technologies.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to write, debug, refactor, and test code.
* Maintain an experimental mindset, trying AI\-assisted approaches on their own work and comparing against writing by hand.
Share learnings on AI\-assisted workflows and ask questions when results are unclear.  
* 

  

**Ownership and Collaboration**

* Responsible for the development and testing of their own code.
* Participate in the code review process for learning and improving code quality.
* Collaborate with the Development team and receive support and supervision from team members as needed.
* Produce content for documents, guides, and manuals for internal applications, development processes, and operating processes for current and future team members.

**Mentorship and Team Building**


* Receive mentorship from senior team members.
* Understand and participate in a respectful team culture.

*Perform other duties as assigned, consistent with the scope of the role.*  



  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
--------------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or computer science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience gained in co\-op programs or summer placements beneficial
* Experience with web development, databases, and programming

**Knowledge**


You don't need experience with every item listed below; familiarity with similar or equivalent technologies is welcome.


* Understanding of computer science fundamentals and object\-oriented design principles
* Familiarity with C\# or other C\-like programming languages
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Understanding of database concepts and SQL basics
* Basic knowledge of software security fundamentals
Knowledge of source control software (e.g., GIT)  
* 

  

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

As an early\-stage company, Peloton employees are also Peloton owners — you'll earn stock in the company through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).  



  

Peloton is a fully remote workplace. You'll work from wherever you're based in Canada, with all the equipment you need provided and dedicated support from the team. We come together in person through regional hubs for townhalls and events.  



  

This position also offers a competitive benefits plan designed to support you and your family, including extended health care, dental, counselling services, and life insurance.  



  

The annual salary range for this position is determined via job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, market demand, and internal equity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Cority
  
Cority helps customers see and prevent risks across their operations in real time. Our EHS\+ platform converges people, data, and AI agents to provide a clear view of information people can trust, automate workflows that make people more impactful, and deliver personalized insights and expertise to improve decision\-making. While most solutions respond to risks one at a time, Cority helps prevent them across environmental management, employee health, safety, quality, and sustainability. For 40 years, Cority has been the market leader in EHS\+, recognized by top analysts and trusted by more than 1,500 of the most complex organizations worldwide. Cority has received many awards for its strong employee culture and outstanding business performance.
  
To learn more, visit www.cority.com.
  
  

Cority is looking for a Software Engineer to be a part of our existing team. Our organization is a dynamic, fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment. We are looking for a passionate team player who is committed to the success of the collective group. The successful candidate will be able to leverage their excellent technical capabilities and drive while delivering immediate value and influencing our long\-term roadmap. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly skilled and dynamic team. We take the success of our customers incredibly seriously and our team is a critical part of this success.
  
  

Reporting to the Development Manager, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for designing and enhancing base Cority software, as well as working with Product Development to develop software to meet client needs.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Drive technical and architectural decisions to meet product requirements while also anticipating and designing for future needs.
* Lead teams technically to drive production ready code.
* Design and develop new software and enhance existing software for clients’ systems, and for Cority’s base software.
* Communicate directly with Product Owners to ensure that requirements and specifications are understood.
* Develop high\-quality software and is an advocate of automation frameworks for testing, integration, and deployment.
* Review completed software designs or prototypes with team and participates in code reviews
* Tracks sprint work and provides proper transparency/visibility to their team
* Provide support and maintenance.
* Own one or more functional area’s or projects and help breakdown task into manageable stories.
* Mentor junior developers.
* Open to learning and working with modern technologies as required in the project.


**Qualifications:**  

* Must have a university degree in computer science or a related program.
* 4\+ years of experience as a developer.
* Strong understanding of software development process \& lifecycle.
* Experience with Agile \& Scrum methodology.


**Technical Qualifications:**  

Must Have \-
  
* Experience with using AI for development including tools like Github Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.
* Experience with .NET Core, .Net Framework, Entity Framework/Dapper, Web APIs and Microservices.
* Experience developing of database applications using relational database systems such as Postgres, SQL Server.
* Experience with Node, Angular/React, HTML5, CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python.
* Experience with CI and CD.


Nice to Have \-
  
* Experience with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks, RAG, Vector DB’s \& MCP servers.
* Experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB.
* Experience with AWS or Azure.
* Experience with Multi\-tenancy.
* Experience with Message Queues like SQS, Google Queues, RabbitMQ, Kafka.
* Experience with Docker.


**Soft Skills:**  

* Proven passion for technology and can navigate your way across complex and rapidly changing landscapes by staying on top of the latest trends.
* A self\-starter who actively challenges the status\-quo, is curious and not afraid to ask “why” and “what”.
* Fantastic communications (written and oral), who thrives on sharing and gaining knowledge.
* Experience working with remote teams.
* Previous experience in the field of occupational health, environment, ergonomics or safety is an asset.


\#LI\-Remote
  
  

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
  
* An opportunity to work in a values\-driven, performance oriented, dynamic and growth focused culture
* We support a remote working environment with a one\-time home office allowance and subsidized monthly internet allowance
* Competitive health benefits, dental plans, and retirement savings plan (RRSP, 401K plan etc.)
* Annual fitness allowance
* Mental health support provided through access to Calm Premium meditation app and access to Talkspace
* Access to learning tools \& platforms, internal training programs, annual training allowance and certifications (if applicable), and High Talent Programs


Cority is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. Cority is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, age, disability or any other legally protected status. For applicants who would like to request for accommodation please send an email to hr@cority.com.

jobs.title: Junior Data Developer
jobs.description:
Salary Details: The salary range for this position is CAD $35\.37/Hr. \- CAD $50\.85/Hr. Job Summary:
**Come work as a Junior Data Developer with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!**  

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for a Junior Data Developer to join the Data and Analytics team. Apply today to join our team! **As a Junior Data Developer with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:**  

* Be responsible for building and deploying data solutions and pipelines across on\-premises, public, private, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Support projects covering all programs/services within Data and Analytics and throughout Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH).
* Be responsible for implementing the design of data models defined by the data solutions architects and will be responsible for troubleshooting data models and developing data pipelines that implement business logic.
* Work closely with project managers, leadership and other functions across the department and VCH.
* Collaborate with the Senior and Principal Data Developers, VCH business and analytics teams, and other teams on cross\-functional projects.
* With a primary focus of ensuring Data and Analytics’ ability to deliver and promote on\-premises and cloud\-based data solutions within the approved enterprise environments, support the effort in the areas of migration and in those environments.

  

This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti\-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.  


Qualifications:
**Education \& Experience**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management or a data intensive related field plus at least one (1\) years’ experience as a Data Engineer or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Data Engineering related certification from at least one cloud service provider preferred (e.g. Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate).

 **Knowledge \& Abilities**  

* Experience developing in SQL languages such as T\-SQL, PL/SQL, Databricks SQL
* Experience implementing data infrastructure, database, and data solutions with on\-prem and cloud tools.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience optimizing data solutions and pipelines ensuring scalability, performance, and cost effectiveness are addressed.
* Knowledge of Python, Scala, and Spark with an ability to write efficient and scalable code for data processing/transformation tasks would be an asset.
* Demonstrated understanding of coding best practices would be an asset.
* Experience in data modeling, ETL development, and data warehousing architecture with solid knowledge of various industry standards would be an asset.
* Understanding of software data development, deployment and release processes, and automated test frameworks.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and related data services (e.g Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake) would be an asset.
* Demonstrated analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem\-solving, presentation, budgeting, project management (from conception to completion), \& planning skills.
* Demonstrated interpersonal skills including strengths in working in a team environment with a client/user orientation.
* Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
* Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity\-deserving groups.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-disciplinary teams with different lines of reporting.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas and processes in simple terminology to internal and external stakeholders, including all levels of management.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT PROMPT.IO**



Prompt.io™ is the winning and influence engine partnered with organizations of all size and scale to engage and activate supporters. Prompt.io™ is a non\-partisan company and we work with customers of all political stripes. We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission\-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting, voice, and engagement tools.



We're a growing tech company where individual contributions can have an outsized impact. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, and are excited to help build what comes next.


**ABOUT THE ROLE**



Prompt.io™ is looking for a Software Engineer to help build, maintain, and improve the technology that powers our platform. You'll work closely with Product to develop new features, improve existing functionality, and ensure our applications are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.  

We're looking for an engineer who can independently own and deliver technical work, make sound decisions within their area, and collaborate effectively with the broader team. You'll work across different parts of our technology stack and have meaningful ownership of the products and systems you help build.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Design, build, test, and maintain** production web applications, services, and APIs.
* **Own features and technical projects** from development through deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* **Collaborate with Engineering and Product** to scope, design, and deliver new features and improvements.
* **Develop and maintain** services and APIs that power our applications.
* **Write** clean, reusable, well\-tested, and maintainable code.
* **Work across front\-end and back\-end systems** to deliver complete solutions.
* **Troubleshoot and resolve** bugs, performance issues, and production problems.
* **Contribute to** the performance, scalability, reliability, and security of our applications.
* **Participate in** code reviews, technical discussions, and team planning.
* **Contribute to** improving our development practices and overall code quality.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating the ability to independently contribute to production software.
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science.
* Strong experience developing web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience with front\-end frameworks such as React.
* Experience with Java or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Experience building and consuming APIs and working with service\-based architectures.
* Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
* Familiarity with microservices and cloud\-based applications.
* Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
* Understanding of software testing, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot technical problems and deliver solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.


**HOW YOU WORK**


* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You're a creative problem solver who finds practical solutions when challenges arise.
* You care about building quality software that is reliable and maintainable.
* You balance attention to detail with getting meaningful work into production.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate well with Engineering, Product, and other teams.
* You seek feedback, share what you know, and contribute to making the team better.
* You work effectively in a fully remote environment and manage your time and priorities well.


**NICE TO HAVE**


* Experience working in a startup or high\-growth technology environment.
* Experience building SaaS products.
* Experience with high\-volume applications, APIs, or messaging systems.
* Experience with communications or messaging technology.


**BENEFITS**


**We believe great work starts with supporting great people.** Prompt.io™ offers a wide range of benefits, including a 401(k) match, health benefits for you and your family, unlimited flexible time off, philanthropic endeavors, annual team gatherings, professional development opportunities, and more.


**COMPENSATION**



The salary range for this position is **$100,000–$150,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors.


**A NOTE TO APPLICANTS**



We don't expect every great candidate to check every box. If you're excited about the work and believe you can be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't perfectly match every item above.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



Prompt.io is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.



Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada and not require sponsorship of a visa, unless otherwise specified in the posting.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Take your career to new heights with Loopio!**
================================================

Loopio’s Data Engineering Team works together on a mission to transform the RFP response process into a rapid and seamless experience. Our team works across all platform portfolio features and delivers innovative solutions where it matters the most for our customers.


We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to build and support the delivery of data pipelines, used for analytics both internally by Loopio’s teams, embedded within the Loopio platform for our customers. Our perfect candidate has deep technical skills and is comfortable working in an evolving technology infrastructure. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing team of creative and passionate individuals committed to solving real world problems. You will empower engineers, product, and data scientists with tools that enable and streamline data\-driven decision making, analysis, and feature development.


You will partner closely with ML Engineers, Architects and Data Scientists, Product Managers, and other business stakeholders to help us take Loopio’s data value to the next level.

*Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team*

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Be responsible for building, evolving and scaling data platforms and ETL pipelines, with an eye towards growth of our business and reliability of our data
* Promote data\-driven decision making across the organization through data expertise
* Build advanced automation tooling for data orchestration, evaluation, testing, monitoring, administration, and data operations
* Integrate various data sources into our Datalake, including clickstream, relational, and unstructured data
* Developing and maintaining a feature store for use in analytics \& modeling
* Partner with data scientists to create predictive models to help drive insights and decisions, both in Loopio’s product and internal teams (RevOps, Marketing, CX)
* Work closely with stakeholders within and across teams to understand the data needs of the business and produce processes that enable a better product and support data\-driven decision\-making
* Build scalable data pipelines using Databricks, and AWS (Redshift, S3, RDS), and other cloud technologies
* Build and support Loopio’s data warehouse (Redshift) and data lake (Databricks deltalake)
* Orchestrate pipelines using workflow frameworks / tooling

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**
---------------------------------

* Strong understanding of database concepts, modeling, SQL, query optimization
* Ability to learn fast and translate data into actionable business results
* Experience in either Python (preferrably), or other common programming language (Scala, Java) for data manipulation purposes
* Hands\-on experience with the AWS services (RDS, S3, Redshift, Glue, Quicksight, Athena, ECS)
* Strong understanding of relational databases (RDS/Aurora) and NoSQL engines (Redis/DynamoDB/Neptune/etc).
* Experience with ETL \& Data warehousing, building Inmon/Kimball/Data Vault models
* Experience with MPP frameworks such as Spark / Flink
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins) and pipeline orchestration tools (Databricks Jobs, Airflow)
* Experience working with data visualization and BI platforms (Quicksight, Tableau, Sisense, etc)
* Experience working with Clickstream data (Amplitude, Pendo, etc)
* Experience in a high growth agile software development environment
* Experience building and supporting large\-scale systems in a production environment
* Strong communication, collaboration, and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of ambiguity, and leadership within a team (mentorship, ownership, innovation)
* 3\+ years experience in a data engineering or a similar role
* Ability to clearly communicate technical roadmap, challenges, and mitigation

**Bonus Qualifications**
------------------------

* Experience with container orchestration (leveraging tools like Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
* Experience working with BI PaaS / SaaS solutions
* Experience with Natural Language Processing techniques
* Experience in AI\-augmented SDLC
* Experience with graph\-like data and corresponding data engines (Neo4J, Neptune, GraphFrames)

**Where You’ll Work**
---------------------

* Loopio is a remote\-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world from which we hire.
* Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), London, and India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru).
* The majority of our team is based in ON and BC, which means these employees live and work remotely within a 300km radius of Toronto (within Ontario) and Vancouver (Within BC).
* We offer flexible co\-working locations available to Loopers in ON and BC. Those based in ON have the option of working out of our convenient co\-working space located in the heart of Downtown Toronto and a 12\-minute walk from Union Station. BC Loopers have the option to work centrally in Vancouver. It is whatever works best for you!
* You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work during the workday
* We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global \#OneTeam!

  

**Why You’ll Working at Loopio**
--------------------------------

* Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1\-on\-1s, we leverage **Lattice**for our 1:1s and performance conversations
* You will have the opportunity to elevate your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.
* We offe
