jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, Client Facing
jobs.description:
**Hiring in Toronto Canada Only**  

  

**About Us**


Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI Agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.


Each AI Agent is purpose\-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher\-value work.


Built on a CX\-native foundation, Observe.AI helps leading brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, Signify Health, and Verida improve customer satisfaction, boost agent productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.


**Why Join Us**


We’re looking for an AI Agent Engineer to lead the charge in building and deploying enterprise\-grade Voice, Chat AI agents and AI Copilot. This role is hands\-on, customer\-facing, and pivotal in bringing AI solutions to life \- from design and integration to deployment and optimization.


You’ll own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI Agents: building, integrating, testing, demoing to clients, deploying into production, and tuning performance.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* **Build \& Deploy Agents**: Own the implementation of AI Agents including prompt design, workflow configuration, integrations, telephony setup, and evaluation frameworks.
* **Client Engagement:** Act as the primary technical partner for customers—lead regular demos, communicate progress, gather feedback, and guide solutions from concept to production.
* **Systems Integration:** Configure and connect systems using APIs—handling authentication, data mapping, error handling, and integrations with CRMs, knowledge bases, and other enterprise tools.
* **Telephony Integration:** Set up SIP/CCaaS/PSTN routing, pass metadata, configure fallbacks, and troubleshoot call quality.
* **Prompt Design \& Optimization:** Write and refine prompts for LLM\-driven agents, monitor performance, test iteratively, and ensure agents meet automation and containment targets.
* **Strategic Partner:** Translate customer requirements into actionable solutions; work consultatively to unblock challenges in security, connectivity, or knowledge ingestion.
* **Cross Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate with product/engineering teams to escalate platform gaps and resolve deep technical fixes and platformization, while independently driving leading client implementations.

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* 3\+ years in conversational AI, solution engineering, system integration, or delivering AI/LLM\-based applications in customer environments, software engineering, or system integration with hands\-on delivery of AI/LLM\-based solutions.
* Strong ability to communicate and lead customer\-facing discussions \- from deep technical troubleshooting to weekly project demos. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Must have strong hands\-on skills in prompt design, workflow building and API integration (SIP, Twilio, Amazon Connect, etc.).
* Familiarity with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini), vector DBs, and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
* Working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, implementation patterns and performance optimization.
* Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or similar for scripting and integrations
* Strong problem\-solving mindset: ability to find workarounds, unblock integrations, and adapt to customer\-specific ecosystems.
* Experience with integration tools and Integration Platform\-as\-a\-Service (iPaaS) providers, such as n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms and proficiency in API integrations and data flow management is a plus.
* Familiarity with telephony or voice systems (SIP, CCaaS, PSTN) is a plus.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**


* Competitive compensation including equity
* Private Health Insurance. The coverage includes prescription drugs, dental care, vision care, paramedical services, mental health benefits, and bundled life insurance, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP)
* Monthly stipend to support work from home.

**Salary Range**


The base salary compensation range targeted for this full\-time position is **$120,000 \- 160,000 CAD**per year.


Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.


**Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging**


*Observe.AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.*


*If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and you're ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Generative AI)
jobs.description:
**JOB POSTING:** AI Engineer (Generative AI)
  
  

About MNEE AppMNEE App is a financial technology company building simpler, faster ways for people and businesses to move and use money in the digital economy.
  
Our vision is to make digital finance more accessible by bringing everyday financial tools and digital assets together. MNEE App combines a checking account, debit card, and crypto in one place, giving customers a simpler way to manage their money.
  
We’re also building the infrastructure to make stablecoins practical for everyday commerce. Through MNEE Pay, merchants can accept stablecoin payments through their existing checkout and POS environments, with lower transaction costs, fast settlement, global reach, and no chargebacks.
  
We’re building at the intersection of fintech, digital assets, payments, and emerging technology, and we’re growing a global team of people who want to help shape what comes next.
  
We are seeking an AI Engineer with exposure to advanced analytics to join our growing generative\-AI program and help expand it across the company!
  
  

About the Role
  
You will build and operate LLM\-powered agents and generative\-AI applications, taking agentic use cases from ideation to deployment, and support the business with advanced analytics. A generative\-AI advocacy mindset is welcomed.
  
You will be part of the Reporting and Analytics team, reporting to the Manager, Reporting \& Analytics. You will work closely with teams across the company to identify high\-value use cases and bring AI solutions into their daily operations.
  
This role is remote with a preference for applicants based in Canada and in the Eastern Time Zone (ET).
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Take agentic use cases from ideation to deployment: scope with stakeholders, prototype, evaluate, and ship to production.
* Engineer the full agent stack on managed platforms such as Amazon Bedrock: prompt design, tool / function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), conversation memory and context management, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Integrate AI agents into business workflows and enterprise systems — REST APIs, SQL data warehouses, messaging platforms, and third\-party tools.
* Build evaluation and guardrails for LLM applications: automated regression testing, output quality benchmarks, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Work with emerging agent interoperability standards — Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent\-to\-agent (A2A) communication, and shared agent memory.
* Deliver advanced analytics — deep\-dive analyses, SQL data products, and reporting that answer high\-value business questions.
* Stay current with the generative\-AI landscape and evaluate new models, frameworks, and techniques.
* Support AI adoption across teams through demos, documentation, and enablement.


How We Get Things Done – Our ICONIC Values
  
Our ICONIC values shape how every RockWallet team member works. We look for a Project Manager who brings them to life every day:
  
* Integrity – Does the right thing, even when it’s inconvenient; raises risks and concerns early rather than working around them, and treats customer trust and data security as non\-negotiable.
* Collaborative – Works across boundaries and avoids silos; shares information proactively, seeks input from relevant stakeholders, and prioritizes organization outcomes over individual or team wins.
* Ownership – Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; follows through on commitments, closes loops, and thinks end\-to\-end about impact on customers, teams, and the business.
* Nimble – Adapts quickly while staying disciplined; responds effectively to change, balances speed with sound judgment and compliance, and avoids over\-engineering when simpler solutions will work.
* Innovative – Continuously improves how we work and what we deliver; challenges outdated processes and uses data, experimentation, and new tools—including AI—to drive practical improvement.
* Customer – Puts the customer at the center of decisions; designs solutions that reduce friction and balances business goals with customer trust and experience.


**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications:**  

* 3 to 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or applied AI.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with the habits of a production engineer: version control, code review, testing.
* Hands\-on experience shipping LLM applications: prompt engineering, function calling, RAG, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or cloud\-native agent SDKs).
* Experience building and running services on a major cloud (AWS preferred: Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM).
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability — measuring quality, reliability, latency, and cost of AI systems.
* Comfortable with modern engineering workflows: Git\-based code review, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Awareness of security, privacy, and governance considerations when deploying AI on sensitive data.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Must be flexible and able to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to Have
  
* Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), Amazon Bedrock, or agent\-to\-agent orchestration.
* Background in data science or classical machine learning (anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation).
* Experience building internal tools or integrating platforms such as Slack, CRMs, or ticketing systems.

* Work from home

* Work\-life balance and support for career development

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About** **Velixo**  

Velixo builds Excel\-native reporting, planning, and automation for finance teams running Acumatica, Sage Intacct, Business Central, and MYOB. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Montreal, we serve finance and accounting teams who live in spreadsheets and need their ERP data to be live, trustworthy, and writable.  

  

Velixo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  

  

This is a fully remote position. While we welcome applications from across Canada, we are giving priority to candidates located in Quebec at this time.  

  

**The role**  

You will own how well Velixo Intelligence works and what it costs us to run. That means building the evaluation infrastructure that tells us whether a model change made our product better or worse, and driving down the cost per action without degrading quality.


This is a measurement\-first engineering role. Today we ship AI features and form opinions about quality from anecdotes. You will replace that with evidence.

**About Velixo Intelligence**


Velixo Intelligence is our MCP\-based gateway that lets finance teams query their ERP in natural language and perform governed writebacks from Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot. Reads run through GIQL, our query language. Writes go through the ERP's own screen APIs so that every permission, validation, and audit rule still applies.


It launched in public preview this year. Usage is growing, the surface area is expanding, and our understanding of the unit economics has not kept pace. That gap is the reason this role exists.

**What you will own**


Evaluation

* Build and maintain regression suites for GIQL query generation, writeback correctness, and tool selection
* Define what "good" means for each action type and make it measurable
* Run structured evaluations before every model upgrade or prompt change, and produce a clear ship or no\-ship recommendation
* Track quality over time so we notice degradation before customers do


Cost engineering

* Instrument every Gateway action for tokens, cache behavior, model, latency, and tenant
* Establish and maintain the cost\-per\-action baseline that the rest of the company plans against
* Reduce cost through prompt compression, prompt caching, context pruning, and routing work to smaller models where evaluation shows quality holds
* Identify the expensive tail: which customers, which query shapes, which failure and retry loops


Model strategy

* Track new model releases across providers and evaluate them against our workloads rather than published benchmarks
* Maintain a current view of the price and performance frontier for what we do
* Recommend when to migrate, when to wait, and when to run models in parallel


Partnership with Finance

* Supply the unit cost data behind our credit pricing and plan allowances
* Model the margin impact of proposed pricing changes alongside our VP Finance
* Flag when product decisions will move the cost curve before they ship


You will not own pricing decisions. You will own the numbers those decisions depend on.


First 90 days

* Days 1 to 30: Full instrumentation of the Gateway. A dashboard showing cost per action type, per tenant, and per model that the exec team checks weekly.
* Days 31 to 60: A working evaluation suite covering our highest\-volume action types, with a documented baseline.
* Days 61 to 90: A prioritized cost reduction roadmap with sized estimates, and at least one shipped optimization with measured before\-and\-after quality.

**What we are looking for**

* Substantial experience building on LLM APIs in production, not in demos or notebooks
* You have built an eval harness before and can explain why the naive version of it misleads you
* Hands\-on with the current tooling landscape: tracing and observability platforms such as Langfuse, eval frameworks such as promptfoo. You have opinions about which of these earn their keep and which add ceremony without adding signal.
* Comfortable with token accounting, context window management, and caching strategies
* Strong analytical instincts and fluency with data. You reach for a query or a notebook before you reach for an opinion.
* Able to write clearly about tradeoffs for a non\-technical audience, because your conclusions will land in board decks and pricing meetings
* Python or TypeScript proficiency

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP or other tool\-calling frameworks
* Background in ERP, accounting, or financial systems
* Prior exposure to usage\-based or credit\-based pricing models
* Experience at a small company where you set your own priorities

**Why this role is interesting**


Most companies bolt a chat box onto their product and hope. We are building governed, auditable write access to financial systems of record, where a wrong answer has real consequences and a hallucinated journal entry is unacceptable. The evaluation problem here is genuinely hard and genuinely matters.


You will also have unusual visibility. The numbers you produce will directly shape what we charge and what we build.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Automation
jobs.description:
#### **About us**



Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.


Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**



We are hiring a Software Engineer for the Automation team to use AI to solve and automate manual work across Coalition. This is a hands\-on AI engineering role: authoring skills, wiring agents to our systems of record through MCP, building evals, and deploying agents that non\-engineers depend on every day. You will not be starting from zero. We have early workflows live in production, more proofs of concept in the oven, and working hypotheses about how all of this should fit together. We want someone who will pressure test those hypotheses against their own experience and change our minds where we have it wrong. Deep, current, practical experience building with LLMs is the single most important qualification for this job.



The other half of the role is proximity to the business. Think of this as a Forward Deployed Engineer, pointed inward: your customers are other Coalition teams. You will work directly with the teams whose work we are automating, learn how they actually operate, and turn that into a playbook. Getting from that conversation to something an agent can run reliably is the core of the work. You will also work day to day with our data team to get at the data these agents depend on. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.



#### **Responsibilities**


* **Author skills:** Turn a team's process, judgment, and edge cases into reusable skills that agents can invoke. Write them so the next project can reuse them instead of rebuilding them.
* **Build within our agent architecture:** Wire agents to the systems of record through MCP servers, compose skills and tools into working workflows, and add new MCP surface area when a system we need is not covered yet.
* **Build evals:** Define what "correct" means with the business team before you build. Build the eval set, establish a baseline, and use it to make calls about what ships. Nothing goes live on vibes.
* **Deploy and support agents:** Take agents from prototype to production, including permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and rollback. Tune from how they behave once real users are in front of them, and leave behind docs and an owner on the business team who can run it without you.
* **Partner with the data team:** Work with our data engineers on the access, models, and quality of the data your agents read and write. Bring them requirements early rather than working around them.

#### **Skills and Qualifications**


* **AI application building (primary):** Substantial hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-backed applications: prompting, tool use, agentic loops, and multi\-step workflows. You know where these break and how to contain the damage when they do. You have shipped at least one agent that non\-engineers depend on.
* **Agent tooling:** Practical experience with MCP, skill or tool authoring, and orchestrating agents against real systems of record.
* **Evals:** You have built eval sets and used them to make decisions, not just to make a slide look good.
* **Coding agents:** Fluent with agentic coding tools like Cursor. You use them to move faster inside codebases you did not write.
* **Core development:** Strong Python. Comfortable with SQL and working directly against production data models.
* **Business fluency:** You can sit with a non\-technical operator, map their process, and translate it into requirements without a PM in the room.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:** Undocumented processes, half\-broken internal tools, and unclear ownership are the normal starting conditions. You find the thread and pull it.
* **Shipping discipline:** Git, CI, containers, and enough operational instinct to deploy your own work and keep it healthy.
* **Experience:** At least 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience. It's not the years, it's the miles.


**Bonus Points**


* Experience building or maintaining MCP servers.
* Prior solutions engineering, professional services, internal tools, or startup founding experience.
* Working knowledge of the systems we automate against: Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, Snowflake.
* Insurance, fintech, or another regulated domain where being wrong has a compliance cost.

#### **Compensation**



As a remote\-first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several Canadian geographic markets.



In Alberta, British Columbia \& Ontario the base salary for this position ranges from $128,500/year up to $160,600/year.



For all other locations, the base salary for this position ranges from $115,600/year up to $144,540/year.



Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job\-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your Recruiter can share more on the specific target salary range for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.


**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for an existing vacancy.


**Use of AI:** We utilize AI\-assisted tools to help us organize and review the high volume of applications we receive. However, our human recruiting team makes all final hiring decisions and interview selections, valuing personal connection over algorithms.


**Application Updates:** Consistent with our commitment to transparency, if you are interviewed for this role, we will provide a status update on your application within 45 days of your final interview.

jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.


We are looking for an experienced, adaptable Software Engineer to join the Securities Finance and Collateral Management (SFCM) engineering team at Broadridge. In this hands\-on role, you will build and maintain high\-performance financial systems, strengthen test automation, and provide technical leadership on large\-scale projects from design through delivery. You will work across engineering and quality assurance, balancing reliability, security, performance, and cost while helping the team explore better ways to solve complex problems.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop, document, and maintain core SFCM Platform components, writing clean, efficient, reliable code as part of an agile squad.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the software development life cycle, guiding implementation, design updates, and the resolution of complex technical challenges.
* Evaluate architectural options, frameworks, infrastructure, and third\-party tools; make technology recommendations that account for scalability, security, performance, long\-term maintainability, and cost versus benefit.
* Build and improve automated integration tests, champion test\-driven development (TDD) and behavior\-driven development (BDD), and help deliver resilient software.
* Establish and promote coding standards, tooling guidelines, and secure development practices. Support compliance with enterprise and regulatory security requirements throughout the SDLC.
* Review code and critical designs, mentor developers, and contribute to technical discussions that raise engineering standards across the team.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical plans, working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA teams, engineering colleagues, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate designs through clear documentation, including diagrams, flowcharts, and other appropriate artifacts. Help manage technical risks, delivery timelines, and budget considerations.
* Experiment thoughtfully with new approaches and technologies, using evidence to improve the platform and its development practices.

 **Skills and Experience**

  

We are looking for a self\-starter with a growth mindset and experience in a strong combination of the following areas:

	+ Oracle PL/SQL

* Sound judgment in software design and technology selection, with attention to performance optimization, security, maintainability, and cost.
* Familiarity with automation and testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, JMeter, and Cucumber.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - GenAI / Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Tiger Analytics is looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineer** with Gen AI experience to join our fast\-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.


We are looking for top\-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world.
  

  

**Role Overview:**  

  

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of client problem\-solving and hands\-on AI engineering. You'll partner directly with clients and engineering teams to turn complex business challenges into production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — owning the journey from first conversation to live deployment.

 **Requirements**  

* Partner directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design, build, deploy, and scale LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi\-agent workflows.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data, APIs, databases, and business applications.
* Deploy, operate, and scale solutions in production cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot and optimize production systems for performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost.
* Collaborate closely with architects, ML engineers, developers, and client stakeholders in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments.

**Qualifications:**

**Engineering Foundation**

* 7\+ years in software engineering, application development, ML engineering, or AI engineering.
* Strong Python programming skills.
* Solid grasp of APIs, system design, databases, cloud\-native applications, and production deployments.
* JavaScript/TypeScript experience is a plus.

**GenAI / Agentic AI Expertise**

* Proven experience building and deploying end\-to\-end GenAI and/or Agentic AI solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and open\-source models.
* Hands\-on experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool/function calling, and AI agents.
* Experience with agent orchestration, multi\-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or similar.
* Working knowledge of MCP, A2A, or similar agent integration protocols.

**Cloud \& Production**

* Hands\-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or GCP — including targeted expertise in:
* **AWS Stack:** Designing workflows via Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama), deploying scalable RAG using OpenSearch Serverless (Vector Engine), and configuring Bedrock Guardrails for client VPCs.
* **Azure Stack:** Deploying enterprise LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service (PTU optimization), building hybrid RAG systems with Azure AI Search, and orchestrating flows using Azure AI Foundry and Semantic Kernel.
* **GCP Stack:** Scaling applications within Vertex AI, managing production pipelines, structuring enterprise RAG with Vertex AI Vector Search \+ BigQuery, and building agentic flows with Gemini APIs.
* Exposure to LLM evaluation, observability, monitoring, guardrails, or LLMOps.

**The FDE Mindset**

* Strong customer\-facing communication and sharp problem\-solving instincts.
* Comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and moving fast from problem solution production.
* Equally at home with business and technical stakeholders.

 **Benefits**  

This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast\-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility.

***Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.title: AI Automation & Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**


The AI Automation \& Software Engineer designs, builds, and supports AI, automation, and software solutions for both customer environments and WBM's internal operations. You'll work across cloud, automation, integration, and AI technologies to deliver secure, scalable solutions that solve real business challenges.

#### **ABOUT WBM**


WBM Technologies is a Western Canadian leader in Managed IT, Security, Data, AI, and Digital Transformation solutions. We help organizations improve efficiency, automate processes, and unlock business value through technology.

#### **WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**AI \& Automation Solutions**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation and orchestration workflows using platforms such as n8n, UiPath, Azure services, and related technologies.
* Build intelligent automation solutions that streamline business processes, improve service delivery, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop AI\-powered workflows and conversational experiences that integrate with collaboration tools, communication channels, and business applications.
* Prototype and deploy innovative AI agents and automation solutions that support new service offerings and internal operational improvements.

**Software Engineering \& Integration**

* Develop and support reusable applications, services, APIs, and integrations for customer and internal environments.
* Build scalable cloud\-native solutions leveraging Azure App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and modern DevOps practices.
* Design integrations between enterprise systems, AI platforms, managed services tools, and business applications.
* Create reusable software components that can be consistently deployed across multiple customer environments.

**Data \& AI Engineering**

* Design and implement data ingestion, collection, and processing pipelines.
* Prepare and optimize structured and unstructured data for analytics, search, and AI\-driven use cases.
* Support retrieval, indexing, vectorization, and knowledge management solutions that enhance AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with teams to identify opportunities for data\-driven automation and intelligent decision\-making.

**Operational Excellence**

* Own end\-to\-end solution quality through testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Implement observability, security, governance, and lifecycle management practices for production environments.
* Support operational transition into WBM Managed Services and ensure long\-term maintainability of delivered solutions.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, service delivery, and customer teams to ensure successful project outcomes.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

**Required**

* 5\+ years of software engineering, automation, integration, or data engineering experience.
* Strong development experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, and cloud technologies.
* Experience with automation and orchestration platforms such as n8n or UiPath.
* Experience working with AI models, LLMs, prompt engineering, and agent\-based workflows.
* Experience with Azure applications, CI/CD, monitoring, and production environments.
* Strong understanding of application security and secure development practices.

 **Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, ServiceNow, or ConnectWise.
* Familiarity with SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, and data modelling.
* Experience with Azure App Services and AKS.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* Knowledge of ITIL and managed services operations.

#### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Solutions reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
* Applications are secure, reliable, and adopted by users.
* Automation and AI capabilities are successfully transitioned into ongoing support.
* Reusable components help accelerate future deployments.

 **WHY JOIN WBM?**


This is an opportunity to work with emerging AI, automation, and cloud technologies while helping shape the future of WBM's AI and Automation practice. You'll work alongside innovative technical teams delivering solutions that create measurable business impact.

 **ADDITIONAL DETAILS**


WBM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including medical, dental, and disability coverage, as well as a group RRSP program.  

  

 WBM is committed to meaningful community engagement across Western Canada. Team members have opportunities to get involved and contribute to community initiatives.  

  

 Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in WBM.

jobs.title: Software Developer – Process Automation & AI
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a Software Developer to join our high\-impact development team with a focus on office automation and practical AI integration. This is a hands\-on position — you will identify, design, and deliver solutions that reduce repetitive manual work, connect existing systems, and help teams across the business work more efficiently.

This position is suited to someone who can evaluate a process and choose the right automation approach — robotic process automation, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, or a combination — then integrate it with our existing technology stack, including PHP applications, multi\-database environments, and ERP\-driven processes. Success is measured by tangible results in the areas we support — faster cycle time, cleaner data, and less repetitive work for the people closest to the process. We place a strong emphasis on leveraging AI\-assisted tools to enhance productivity and solution quality, and expect this person to apply those practices thoughtfully.

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Partner with stakeholders in finance, purchasing, operations support, and other departments to map current processes and identify high\-value automation opportunities.
* Design, build, and maintain office and business\-process automation using the toolset that best fits the problem — including RPA platforms, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, and scheduled jobs.
* Integrate applications and data across our ERP and supporting systems so information moves reliably without duplicate data entry.
* Develop and support internal tools and intelligent assistants that help teams find information, complete routine requests, and stay consistent with established procedures.
* Contribute to PHP\-based applications and existing web stacks where automation needs to live inside current company platforms.
* Evaluate, prototype, and implement AI\-assisted capabilities in a practical, secure, and business\-appropriate way.
* Support future system implementations and process improvements, including potential people\-services system work, by building integrations and automating surrounding workflows.
* Write, optimize, and maintain queries and stored procedures across multiple database platforms as required by automation and reporting needs.
* Work closely with business analysts and/or directly with business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and refine requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical solutions with well\-defined scope and realistic timelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues promptly and thoroughly; monitor automated jobs and intervene when processes fail.
* Actively leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, improve code quality, and solve problems more efficiently.
* Document systems, processes, and technical decisions to build institutional knowledge.
* Actively and enthusiastically engage in Company vision, mission and values.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience Required:**

* Post\-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in software development, process automation, RPA, or a closely related technical role.
* Hands\-on experience delivering process automation using RPA platforms, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, or a comparable toolset.
* Proven experience with relational databases and SQL — ability to write and optimize queries and stored procedures is required.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders or analysts to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, large language models, and how they can be applied to internal tools or assisted workflows.
* Experience with Python and/or PHP for automation, scripting, integration, or application work is an asset.
* Experience with EDI (electronic data interchange) — including trading\-partner documents, mappings, and exception handling — is an asset.
* Experience with IBM DB2 for i (iSeries/AS400\) is a significant asset.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL is an asset.

* **Job Location**
Toronto
* **Salary Range**
$80,000 to $90,000 (CAD)
**Find the problems worth solving and own the work that solves them.**

  

**The opportunity**
===================

  

Help build the function that turns Entro’s data into better business decisions and action. As its founding builder, you will identify opportunities, put practical solutions into use, and improve them quickly with the people who rely on them. This is a dedicated, full\-time role focused on changes that improve revenue, profitability, and efficiency.

  

You will work frequently with Entro’s most senior leaders and key stakeholders on questions that affect project profitability, staffing, growth, and operational performance. You will investigate what is happening, explain why, recommend what to do, and build tools and workflows that help teams follow through.

  

We are looking for someone who combines commercial judgment and analytical ability with the drive to build. You will learn how Entro earns revenue, delivers projects, and makes money, then use that understanding to choose worthwhile problems and implement solutions. Existing dashboards and analytics give you a foundation to build on.

  

**Why this role**
=================


* Build a function from its early foundations. Shape the roadmap, establish useful working practices, and help decide which problems deserve attention first.
* Have direct access to senior leaders and investors. Present findings and recommendations, learn how the business creates value, and see your work inform real decisions.
* Own improvements from discovery through ongoing use. Help choose the problems, develop and implement solutions, learn from users, and see whether your work improves business results.
  

**Examples of the impact you could have**
=========================================


* Spot a change in project profitability, investigate its drivers, and give the project leader a useful briefing and a way to track corrective action.
* Connect pipeline, backlog, and utilization data so leaders can make better staffing and forecasting decisions, with less manual reporting.
* Help business development keep opportunities moving by identifying stale records, routing follow\-up to owners, and tracking what gets resolved.
  

**How you will work**
=====================

  

You will be Entro’s primary hands\-on technical builder; there is no engineering team. Spend time with the people doing the work to uncover unanswered questions, missing information, and repetitive tasks. Bring their ideas together with leadership priorities to agree a focused roadmap. Own technical delivery and ongoing support, and work with business owners to agree actions, responsibilities, and follow\-through.

  

**What you will build and own**
===============================

  

* Analyze financial, project, operational, and relationship data to identify commercial opportunities. Explain performance drivers and prioritize improvements by expected value, effort, and uncertainty.
* Connect business systems and approved external sources through APIs, connectors, scripts, and scheduled workflows. Reuse data models and integrations across solutions.
* Build trusted dashboards and clear visual summaries. Establish KPI definitions, reconcile figures to source records, and address data quality issues with business leaders.
* Synthesize information across systems to explain trends, variances, and anomalies. Support budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, and profitability reviews; proactively bring findings and recommendations to leadership and key stakeholder discussions.
* Choose the simplest effective solution: a process change, an existing tool, automation, or custom development. Build and deploy practical tools when needed, prototype quickly with users, validate outputs, and improve through short feedback cycles.
* Turn insight into action with business owners. Build follow\-up into regular reviews, observe real usage, and fix missed or awkward steps. Train users and measure adoption, time saved, and business results to guide further improvements.
* Own testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation. Choose maintainable solutions, protect confidential data and credentials, and agree approvals for automated changes to business records.
  

**What you bring**
==================

  

* Commercial and analytical judgment. You can reason about revenue, costs, margins, and capacity, investigate what drives a result, and recommend an action tied to business value.
* Evidence that you build things. Personal projects, small\-business automations, freelance work, school projects, and internships all count. Explain your contribution and what improved.
* Curiosity and initiative. You spot problems and opportunities, learn unfamiliar systems quickly, and make progress without a fully defined brief. You test ideas, investigate failures, and adapt.

**Employer:** HECOD Blockchain Inc.

**Start date:** March 2027 (tentative)  
**Language of work:** English

**ABOUT HECOD**

HECOD Blockchain Inc. is a Vancouver\-based applied technology company. We build software, workflow, and verifiable systems for markets that still run on disconnected spreadsheets, inboxes, and portals.

Our approach is "technology without ideology." We start with the operational problem and choose the tools after. Cloud infrastructure, conventional databases, APIs, workflow automation, and applied AI do most of the work. Blockchain is used only where shared verification and tamper\-evident records add practical value.

Our products:

* **HECOD Collect (controlled preview):** a receivables workspace for B2B service businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and shared inboxes. It brings invoices, follow\-up decisions, and customer responses into one reviewable record.
* **HECOD Shelfware (planned):** software spend and renewal control. It connects finance, IT, and department evidence so an owner can decide whether to keep, investigate, or change a subscription.
* **EVRAYO (in development):** an operating layer for private real estate that connects sponsors, property\-specific entities, and eligible investors from onboarding through distributions.
* **HECOD Block (invitation\-only):** our first launched product, a no\-code blockchain deployment platform.

We also deliver custom software, integration, and advisory work for small businesses, enterprises, and the public sector.

**THE ROLE**

You will build and maintain the web surfaces people actually use: the HECOD Collect application, the customer response portal, and the hecod.tech website.

Collect users are finance people and business owners working through overdue invoices. They need dense, readable tables, clear status, and no surprises. Their customers open a single link to respond about one invoice, often on a phone. The standard for both is calm, fast, accessible, and multilingual from the start.

**MAIN DUTIES**

* Research, design, develop, and produce websites and web applications
* Consult with stakeholders to develop and document website and application requirements
* Prepare mock\-ups, prototypes, and user flows, and develop site and application architecture
* Write, modify, integrate, and test code for web and mobile\-responsive applications

**DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build data tables for invoices and customers with aging, balances, currency, and status, using tabular figures and right\-aligned amounts
* Build approval queues, reminder draft review screens, and follow\-up history views
* Build clear empty, loading, and error states: plain sentences and one action
* Show verified records with the approved verified icon and label, never decorative graphics

Customer response portal

* Build the scoped portal where a customer views one invoice and records a payment promise or dispute
* Make it work well on mobile, with minimal steps and no account required

Localization

* Support EN\-US, FR\-CA, ES, and DE across the application
* Handle language, currency, region, date format, and time zone as separate settings
* Work with translators and reviewers to keep strings accurate and consistent

Design system and accessibility

* Implement and maintain the HECOD design system: tokens, components, typography, and dark mode
* Meet WCAG 2\.2 AA for contrast, keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen readers
* Respect reduced\-motion settings; keep transitions short and purposeful

Website and performance

* Maintain hecod.tech and collect.hecod.tech marketing and documentation pages
* Monitor and improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and reliability
* Write automated tests for components and critical user flows

**REQUIREMENTS**  
Education

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, OR
* College diploma in web development, computer programming, or a related program

Experience

* 3\+ years of professional web development experience
* Experience shipping and maintaining a production web application used by real customers

Technical skills

* Strong TypeScript and JavaScript
* Strong React
* Modern HTML and CSS, including responsive layout
* Building accessible interfaces to WCAG AA standards
* Integrating front ends with REST APIs or database\-backed services
* Front\-end testing (component and end\-to\-end)
* Git, code review, and CI/CD pipelines

Working skills

* Clear written communication in English
* Attention to detail in layout, spacing, and copy
* Comfortable working in a small team without layers of management

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion
* Supabase
* Experience with internationalization libraries and localized number, currency, and date formatting
* Experience building data\-heavy business or finance interfaces
* Experience with design tools such as Figma
* French, Spanish, or German proficiency
* A portfolio or code samples showing business application interfaces

First 3 months

* You understand Collect's interface, component library

About Mate GaugeWhy Join Us?What You'll DoEducation \& Expertise
**About Mate Gauge**
--------------------

Mate Gauge is a leader in laser\-based thickness monitoring systems used in manufacturing facilities around the world. We’re deploying cutting\-edge, non\-contact laser technology that helps manufacturers reduce waste, improve product quality, and lower environmental impact.


Our systems combine:


* Smart, robust sensors
* Seamless production line and data integration
* Production\-tested hardware
* Powerful, intuitive software

We're a tight\-knit, driven team, we move fast, solve complex problems, and have a lot of fun along the way.  

  



**Why Join Us?**
----------------


You’ll be joining a growing company with real momentum, meaningful products, and a clear purpose. In this role you’ll gain hands\-on engineering experience with software, hardware, automation, and customer interaction.  

  

  

As a member of our Engineering Team you will work on a sophisticated code platform used in our products. You will contribute to the design and development of custom measuring apps and to our web app and provide onsite customer support for product installations and troubleshooting.  

  

  

Our customers work with engineers, not sales reps, from the first conversation through install, commissioning and support. We're hiring a new grad who wants to be that engineer and write the software behind it. You'll ship code, then join our customer on their plant floor and watch it run.
**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Months 1–3: Learn the system inside and out**
* Hands\-on training with MG1/MG3/MG5/MGX gauges
* Learn mgOS architecture, measurement apps (Strips, Plates, Zones, Gypsum, Veneer), calibration and PLC integration
* Shadow a colleague providing remote customer support and then participate in a customer installation

**Months 3–12: Build, ship, support**
* **Software development** \- custom mgOS apps and measurement modes for specific customer lines; mgConnect features (status dashboards, daily summaries, trend reports); internal tooling and AI\-assisted workflows
* **QA \& release** \- test measurement and motion software on real hardware before it ships; help build a more repeatable test and commissioning process
* I**nstallation \& commissioning** \- travel to customer plants to install, align, calibrate and hand over systems, including PLC network setup and closed\-loop tuning
* **Customer support** \- remote troubleshooting (phone, video, remote login) and occasional on\-site service visits under our Go\-Flat\-Out plans
* **Requirements \& demos** \- spend time with plant engineers and operators to understand what they actually need, translate that into specs, and demo systems to prospective customers
**Education \& Expertise**
--------------------------


* **Recent Graduate \-** Possess a degree in Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or Software Engineering and ideally have an internship in a related field.
* **On\-site \-** Must be able to work full\-time onsite in our Kanata office \- in\-person daily collaboration with our Engineering, Sales and Marketing teams is essential.
* **Solid programming** fundamentals and use of at least one of Python, C/C\+\+, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, SQLite
* **Comfortable with hardware \-** you've wired a sensor, debugged a serial/Ethernet connection, or built something that moves.
* Willing to learn **LabVIEW** (mgOS is built on it today; mgConnect and new tooling are moving toward Python and web stacks — you'll work in both)
* Familiar with **Claude Code** and/or other LLM/AI developer tools
* **Clear communicator** who can explain a technical problem to a plant operator and a plant manager in the same afternoon
* **Practical, curious, and comfortable when things don't go to plan.**
* **Business Travel \-** About 25% of the time working at customer facilities and attending trade\-shows. Some travel may be outside of North America. Must have a valid Canadian passport \& be eligible to travel without restriction.
* **Driver’s License \-** Possess a valid license used for vehicle rentals, as needed.
* **PEng \-** This is a potential opportunity for an engineer to earn their P.Eng. designation.
  

  

  

**Apply now!**

Vasco is the revenue context layer for AI agents. The product was built around one idea: confident is not the same as correct, and revenue decisions get made on confidence all the time. We structure your CRM, billing, calls, and support data into a semantic layer where every metric is sourced, every definition is locked, and every answer is deterministic, then build agents that take the manual busywork off people's plates.


Our cofounders Guillaume and Seb already built and sold one startup together; today they are building the product they wished they had. Vasco's mission is to enable builders and GTM leaders to build a revenue engine that moves the business forward on data they can trust.


Curious how we build? Take a look at our young engineering blog.

As a Software Engineer at Vasco, you'll build the brain of our agents: the core systems that give them the context, metrics, and playbooks they need to do their job. You'll join a small team of product designers and engineers reporting to our CTO, and work closely with our DevOps, Platform, Data, and Agent teams. The mission is to make GTM agents production\-ready: reliable, fast, context\-aware, and triggered at the right moment. You'll help shape solutions, then carry them through implementation to release. Twelve months in, winning means our agents run on systems you shaped, shipped, and saw adopted, and you’re able to tackle hard and crunchy problems.

new_jobs.description:
**About Nakisa**

Nakisa is a global leader in AI\-powered enterprise software for Human Resources, Financial Management, and Commercial Real Estate (CRE). Our cloud platform powers mission\-critical operations for 1,100\+ organizations in 135 countries and serves millions of users.

We are building the next wave of enterprise applications with Nakisa AI. Our products use retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) with secure API integrations to large language models. Customer data stays private and auditable, and we never use client data to train third\-party models. This privacy\-first design gives enterprises trustworthy AI they can run in production.

What sets us apart is a single platform that connects these functions on shared data models, a focus on high\-stakes, compliance\-heavy workflows, and a culture anchored in Fairness, Integrity, Service, and Humility. Recognized among Canada's top employers, we offer hybrid work, supportive leaders, and clear growth paths. Join us to ship reliable, privacy\-first AI at global scale.  



**About the role**



As a Software Developer on our Platform Engineering team, you will help design, build, and maintain the cloud\-native services and tools that power Nakisa's product portfolio for Fortune 1000 companies around the world. Working within an Agile team, you will contribute to features that improve the deployment, monitoring, and visibility of our microservices, and support the continuous integration and deployment pipelines that our development teams rely on every day. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and DevOps as part of our continued shift toward NoOps\-driven, cloud\-native delivery, growing your full stack and platform engineering skills along the way.

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and their corresponding frontend components for our cloud platform.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Managing trillions of objects in storage, retrieving them in sub\-x ms, building software that deploys to tens of thousands of hosts, achieving 99\.999999999% (you didn’t read that wrong, that’s 11 nines!) durability. These are just a few of the numbers that give you a sense of the scale of the exciting problems you will find every day working in Simple Storage Service (S3\). Amazon S3 powers businesses across e globe that make the lives of consumers better daily. Whether its electronic content delivered to your home, technology that betters your remote working experience, allows you to plan travel to exotic places or simply get stuff delivered to your home.  

  

As a Software Development Engineer in the S3 Distribution Plane team, you will deliver services at scale to delight our customers and support the routing of billions of requests per minute to S3’s globally distributed server fleet. You will have the opportunity to design and develop systems and services in the domains of DNS, IP and Network Connectivity, TLS Certificates, VPC Endpoints and Private Connectivity. You will work alongside engineers and leaders who obsess about operations, performance, availability, scalability, and durability of customer data. Our services run at scale worldwide and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to ship code often, and see the impact your code has on a wide range of S3 customers.

You will partner with service teams across AWS to build ground\-breaking DNS, networking and security solutions in code for S3\. Identifying ways to increase the automate and improve our test infrastructure and make our CI/CD more robust and flexible.

In AWS, if you build it, you own it. S3 is a highly available 7x24 worldwide service requiring dedicated support from our engineering teams. We pride ourselves on a high level of ownership in the work we do. This means we hold a high bar for test automation, verification processes, design and code reviews to ensure that our systems meet the exacting standards our customers demand. We maintain a regular on\-call rotation across our teams with engineers and managers all taking part to resolve the inevitable issues that arise. We work hard to minimize getting paged in the middle of the night as we recognize that a well\-rested employee is a productive employee.

Reporting to the Director, Software Development, you will design, develop, and test financial applications, independently creating small features and contributing to medium\-sized features with support from other developers. Collaborating with the team, you’ll help determine solutions for end users’ needs and work with end user requirements to design and develop code that delivers effective solutions. By applying common design and architectural patterns, you’ll help enhance software structure and functionality while developing and maintaining adequate tests to ensure code correctness and reliability.


This is a great opportunity for someone early in their development career who’s eager to learn and grow. You bring a passion for coding and a commitment to best practices, along with good communication skills and a genuine willingness to pick up new tools and technologies. You enjoy working closely with a team and bringing your own ideas to the table.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Contributions and Expertise**


* Write clean and efficient code and practice the software development lifecycle with supervision from the team.
* Determine possible solutions to the end users' needs with assistance from colleagues.
* Work with end user requirements, designing and developing code to create solutions.
* Apply common design and architectural patterns with direction from the team.
* Write adequate tests to ensure the correctness of code.
* Learn at least one technical area (eg. web application development, database design, API integration, etc.).
* Continuously improve technical skills and stay updated on emerging technologies.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to write, debug, refactor, and test code.
* Maintain an experimental mindset, trying AI\-assisted approaches on their own work and comparing against writing by hand.
Share learnings on AI\-assisted workflows and ask questions when results are unclear.  
* 

  

**Ownership and Collaboration**

* Responsible for the development and testing of their own code.
* Participate in the code review process for learning and improving code quality.
* Collaborate with the Development team and receive support and supervision from team members as needed.
* Produce content for documents, guides, and manuals for internal applications, development processes, and operating processes for current and future team members.

**Mentorship and Team Building**


* Receive mentorship from senior team members.
* Understand and participate in a respectful team culture.

*Perform other duties as assigned, consistent with the scope of the role.*  



  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
--------------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or computer science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience gained in co\-op programs or summer placements beneficial
* Experience with web development, databases, and programming

**Knowledge**


You don't need experience with every item listed below; familiarity with similar or equivalent technologies is welcome.


* Understanding of computer science fundamentals and object\-oriented design principles
* Familiarity with C\# or other C\-like programming languages
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Understanding of database concepts and SQL basics
* Basic knowledge of software security fundamentals
Knowledge of source control software (e.g., GIT)  
* 

  

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

As an early\-stage company, Peloton employees are also Peloton owners — you'll earn stock in the company through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).  



  

Peloton is a fully remote workplace. You'll work from wherever you're based in Canada, with all the equipment you need provided and dedicated support from the team. We come together in person through regional hubs for townhalls and events.  



  

This position also offers a competitive benefits plan designed to support you and your family, including extended health care, dental, counselling services, and life insurance.  



  

The annual salary range for this position is determined via job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, market demand, and internal equity.

About Cority
  
Cority helps customers see and prevent risks across their operations in real time. Our EHS\+ platform converges people, data, and AI agents to provide a clear view of information people can trust, automate workflows that make people more impactful, and deliver personalized insights and expertise to improve decision\-making. While most solutions respond to risks one at a time, Cority helps prevent them across environmental management, employee health, safety, quality, and sustainability. For 40 years, Cority has been the market leader in EHS\+, recognized by top analysts and trusted by more than 1,500 of the most complex organizations worldwide. Cority has received many awards for its strong employee culture and outstanding business performance.
  
To learn more, visit www.cority.com.
  
  

Cority is looking for a Software Engineer to be a part of our existing team. Our organization is a dynamic, fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment. We are looking for a passionate team player who is committed to the success of the collective group. The successful candidate will be able to leverage their excellent technical capabilities and drive while delivering immediate value and influencing our long\-term roadmap. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly skilled and dynamic team. We take the success of our customers incredibly seriously and our team is a critical part of this success.
  
  

Reporting to the Development Manager, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for designing and enhancing base Cority software, as well as working with Product Development to develop software to meet client needs.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Drive technical and architectural decisions to meet product requirements while also anticipating and designing for future needs.
* Lead teams technically to drive production ready code.
* Design and develop new software and enhance existing software for clients’ systems, and for Cority’s base software.
* Communicate directly with Product Owners to ensure that requirements and specifications are understood.
* Develop high\-quality software and is an advocate of automation frameworks for testing, integration, and deployment.
* Review completed software designs or prototypes with team and participates in code reviews
* Tracks sprint work and provides proper transparency/visibility to their team
* Provide support and maintenance.
* Own one or more functional area’s or projects and help breakdown task into manageable stories.
* Mentor junior developers.
* Open to learning and working with modern technologies as required in the project.


**Qualifications:**  

* Must have a university degree in computer science or a related program.
* 4\+ years of experience as a developer.
* Strong understanding of software development process \& lifecycle.
* Experience with Agile \& Scrum methodology.


**Technical Qualifications:**  

Must Have \-
  
* Experience with using AI for development including tools like Github Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.
* Experience with .NET Core, .Net Framework, Entity Framework/Dapper, Web APIs and Microservices.
* Experience developing of database applications using relational database systems such as Postgres, SQL Server.
* Experience with Node, Angular/React, HTML5, CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python.
* Experience with CI and CD.


Nice to Have \-
  
* Experience with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks, RAG, Vector DB’s \& MCP servers.
* Experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB.
* Experience with AWS or Azure.
* Experience with Multi\-tenancy.
* Experience with Message Queues like SQS, Google Queues, RabbitMQ, Kafka.
* Experience with Docker.


**Soft Skills:**  

* Proven passion for technology and can navigate your way across complex and rapidly changing landscapes by staying on top of the latest trends.
* A self\-starter who actively challenges the status\-quo, is curious and not afraid to ask “why” and “what”.
* Fantastic communications (written and oral), who thrives on sharing and gaining knowledge.
* Experience working with remote teams.
* Previous experience in the field of occupational health, environment, ergonomics or safety is an asset.


\#LI\-Remote
  
  

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
  
* An opportunity to work in a values\-driven, performance oriented, dynamic and growth focused culture
* We support a remote working environment with a one\-time home office allowance and subsidized monthly internet allowance
* Competitive health benefits, dental plans, and retirement savings plan (RRSP, 401K plan etc.)
* Annual fitness allowance
* Mental health support provided through access to Calm Premium meditation app and access to Talkspace
* Access to learning tools \& platforms, internal training programs, annual training allowance and certifications (if applicable), and High Talent Programs


Cority is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. Cority is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, age, disability or any other legally protected status. For applicants who would like to request for accommodation please send an email to hr@cority.com.
